identitySignals: Agenda names 'No Barriers Youth/AFAR Foundation' for student travel to Belize at Coliseum College Preparatory Academy (CCPA)
CCPA's own OUSD page says Learning AFAR and No Barriers USA have partnered with CCPA since 2011 on international student expeditions, including Belize
No Barriers USA (Fort Collins, CO; EIN 06-1693441) runs the No Barriers Youth program and its Learning AFAR travel page
The vendor name combines two organizations (No Barriers Youth and the AFAR Foundation, a separate nonprofit in San Francisco, EIN 27-0181444), so which one is the contracting party is unclear
research.notes: The agenda names two organizations joined by a slash: No Barriers Youth (a program of No Barriers USA) and the AFAR Foundation (a separate San Francisco nonprofit, EIN 27-0181444 per ProPublica/GuideStar).
